Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: The Planner miscompared the directors’ birth years, treating Julia Crawford Ivers’s “’69” as later than T. V. Chandran’s “’50” (likely interpreting 1869 as 1969 or using shorthand incorrectly). This led to the incorrect conclusion that The Majesty of the Law’s director was born later, despite the correct data showing 1950 (Chandran) > 1869 (Ivers).
